title: Sketch-thru-Plan call validation rules
description: Schema of sketch-thru-plan-validations.json: per contract method, the checks a client runs before a state-changing call and the events that prove the call did what it asked. See README.md, 'Call validations'.

version.description: Version of the rule file; a change an evaluator must know about raises the major version.

contractVersion.description: The contract version (info.version of sketch-thru-plan-api.json) the rules were checked against.

refusalMessage.description: How the engine announces that it refused a fire-and-forget call: an event whose message contains this text, with {method} replaced by the method name.

methods.description: One entry per write or destructive contract method the engine dispatches, keyed by method name.

preconditions.description: Session state that must hold before the call. activeScenario: the session has an active scenario (HasActiveScenario is true).

required.description: Params that must be present: without them the engine ignores the call and says nothing.

references.description: Params whose value is a poid that must name an existing object of the given kind.

confirm.description: Destructive methods only: what the call destroys, for the confirmation asked of the user. {path} is replaced by that param's value; {path.length} by an array's length.

paramPath.description: A dotted path into the call's params, e.g. task.who. A * segment stands for every item of an array, e.g. task.tgs.*.

eventPath.description: A dotted path into an event's params; a numeric segment indexes an array, e.g. alternates.0.who.

kind.description: symbol: any symbol (unit, tactical graphic, equipment...); unit: a symbol whose fsTYPE is unit; any: an object of any kind.
The kind of object the poid must name, or a list of acceptable kinds.

required.description: true when the call is meaningless without this poid (it names the call's target).

intent.description: How to tell from the event stream that the call did what it asked (V10).

expect.description: The events that prove the call was done; empty when the contract promises no event for it.

other.description: Events that show the engine did something else than asked, e.g. TaskModified instead of TaskAdded. An event on an object an expected event already matched is a follow-on, not something else.

acks.description: Events that show the engine handled the call without proving it was done, e.g. InkProcessed before SymbolAdded.

unverifiable.description: The expected events are not sent today because of a filed engine issue, which the method lists in x-stpKnownIssues: their absence is reported as unverifiable, never as not done.

expectation.description: One expected event (event + match), or one of several (anyOf). With forEach, one is expected per item of that param array (filtered by where).

where.description: Item filter for forEach: the item's value at a path must be in, or not in, a list.

match.description: Equality on dotted paths of the event: each key is an event path, each value says what it must equal. Strings compare without regard to case (the engine changes the case of enum values); a value that resolves to nothing (an absent param) does not constrain the match.

item.description: A path into the current forEach item.
